# Forward Kentucky

> A progressive news and analysis platform providing objective coverage of Kentucky politics, legislation, and activism opportunities.

Forward Kentucky serves as an independent voice in Kentucky political journalism, offering members access to bill tracking, weekly legislative recaps, and in-depth policy analysis. The site combines news reporting with community organizing resources and editorial commentary on state and federal politics affecting Kentucky.

## Key Topics

- Kentucky Legislature
- Kentucky General Assembly
- State Politics
- Election Coverage
- Gun Legislation
- Concealed Carry
- Budget & Fiscal Policy
- Judicial Independence
- Energy Policy
- Democratic Primary
- GOP Commentary
- Legislative Process
- Political Accountability
- Climate & Environment
- Community Organizing

## Getting Started

- [Forward Kentucky](https://www.forwardky.com): Progressive voice for Kentucky politics with objective news and policy analysis
- [Our Values & Value Proposition](https://www.forwardky.com/our-values): Mission statement and editorial policy for Forward Kentucky journalism
- [Joining Forward Kentucky](https://www.forwardky.com/join): Membership details, pricing, benefits, and bill tracking subscription options
- [Your Support](https://www.forwardky.com/your-support): Support options including memberships, donations, and sponsorship information

## Legislative Coverage & Analysis

- [This Week at the State Capitol](https://www.forwardky.com/this-week-at-the-state-capitol-4): Weekly summary of Kentucky General Assembly activity and legislation
- [Latest](https://www.forwardky.com/latest): Weekly news roundup covering Kentucky legislature and state politics
- [Speed dating, Kentucky GOP Legislature-style](https://www.forwardky.com/speed-dating-kentucky-gop-legislature-style): Analysis of House Bill 312 concealed carry legislation and legislative process
- [Senate proposes to ease some House reductions, but austere budget reflects recent tax cuts](https://www.forwardky.com/senate-proposes-to-ease-some-house-reductions-but-austere-budget-reflects-recent-tax-cuts-2): Budget analysis of Kentucky Senate proposal and fiscal policy implications
- [House panel changes controversial provisions in bills affecting Kentucky energy planning](https://www.forwardky.com/house-panel-changes-controversial-provisions-in-bills-affecting-kentucky-energy-planning): Coverage of energy policy changes allowing utility rate intervention advocacy
- [With Judge Goodman impeachment process, legislators make a dangerous move](https://www.forwardky.com/with-judge-goodman-impeachment-process-legislators-make-a-dangerous-move): Commentary on judicial independence and separation of powers concerns

## Election & Campaign Coverage

- [As Trump flails on war, top GOP candidates stick with him](https://www.forwardky.com/as-trump-flails-on-war-top-gop-candidates-stick-with-him): Analysis of GOP primary dynamics and Trump endorsement impact on Kentucky race
- [Seven candidates, two questions; only one response](https://www.forwardky.com/seven-candidates-two-questions-only-one-response): Accountability analysis of Democratic primary candidates' responsiveness
- [This forum highlights four years of change to two environments](https://www.forwardky.com/this-forum-highlights-four-years-of-change-to-two-environments-the-climate-and-the-politics): Climate change and politics intersection in Louisville mayor's race coverage

## News & Commentary

- [Friday news snippets](https://www.forwardky.com/friday-news-snippets): Short weekly news roundup of Kentucky political and legislative updates
- [The Wrap for Friday, 3/20](https://www.forwardky.com/the-wrap-for-friday-3-20): Member-only weekly wrap-up of Kentucky politics and news highlights
- [Kentucky House leader's wife dies, legislature to pause for funeral](https://www.forwardky.com/kentucky-house-leaders-wife-dies-legislature-to-pause-for-funeral): News coverage of Jessica Rudy's passing and legislative pause announcement
- [The village doesn't build itself](https://www.forwardky.com/the-village-doesnt-build-itself): Commentary on women's invisible labor and leadership representation
